name: The Aranta
description: The unmapped interior of Jambhudweep: forest wilderness, and people living in it who the coastal civilizations have not reached.
notes: The render calls it 'Unknown Aranta' and annotates the interior as wilderness with unexplored territory. The 'Unknown' reads as a cartographer's admission rather than part of the name. Ground rather than building: it is here before anyone names it and after they stop. Ground rather than building: it is here before anyone names it and after they stop.
